desc: Implement solve() with fast input parsing (sys.stdin.buffer) for T test cases, sum N ≤ 1e5.
For each test case, for each of 8 sign patterns compute weights w_i = ±X_i ± Y_i ± Z_i, sort indices descending by weight, take top 2K, pair adjacent in sorted order.
Evaluate each candidate pairing with the real price max(Xa+Xb, Ya+Yb, Za+Zb), track the maximum total across patterns.
Print T lines of answers; verify against samples mentally (209, 333) and edge cases (K = N/2, duplicates, zeros).
